title: Biodiversity and Conservation
summary: Why biodiversity matters, threats like deforestation and poaching, and how national parks, corridors and people protect it.

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 7: Conservation of Plants and Animals
Curiosity Ch 12: How Nature Works in Harmony

objectives: I can explain what biodiversity is and why it matters.
I can describe threats to biodiversity and ways to protect it.
I can evaluate land-use decisions that affect people and wildlife.
misconceptions: Conservation means keeping all people out of forests.
Extinction only happens to animals far away.
One small reserve is as good as a large connected one.
